title.narrative: Demonstration project for disposal of unwanted ODS in Mexico

description.narrative: Demonstration project for disposal of unwanted ODS in Mexico The project aims to develop a business model for ODS waste management from collection to disposal, in a way that shows how "seed money" from the MLF can be used within a country to take the banked ODS and destroy it so that it can generate carbon credits. This will create income to those who participate. Thus, the demonstration project will show how this financial mechanism can be used as an incentive to enterprises in A5 countries, such as India, China, Brazil, and Mexico, to participate in carbon trading programs for profit or for lower cost destruction. The aim of the project is to destroy 166.7 ODP tons of used CFC#12 which have already been collected from various sources in Mexico.
